reconstructed_theorem_text:
Let E be the full finite-dimensional real Hilbert/Borel space with canonical full-space volume, including dimension zero and all approved section ambient instances. Let V:E->R, alpha,beta:NNReal and eta:R. Assume alpha cast to R is strictly positive, alpha<=beta, V is C2, and for every x,a:E both exact actual Hessian bounds hold:
  alpha*||a||^2 <= (fderiv R (fderiv R V) x a) a,
  (fderiv R (fderiv R V) x a) a <= beta*||a||^2.
Assume eta>0 and beta*eta<=1. Define actual measures and reflected potential
  mu=volume.tilted(x->-V(x)),
  J=map((x,g)->(x,x+sqrt(eta)*g),mu.prod(stdGaussian E)),
  W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+||z-y||^2/(8*eta).
Tilted means the actual exp(-potential)/partition density against volume; standard Gaussian, independent product and pushforward are genuine measures.
There exist kernels R,S:E->Measure E with all the following simultaneous properties: R and S are Markov kernels; R disintegrates the swapped actual joint J.map Prod.swap; and for every y:E,
  S(y)=(R(y)).map(x->2*x-y).
For every y:E, S(y)=volume.tilted(z->-W_y(z)), W_y is C2, exp(-W_y) is volume-integrable and its volume integral strictly positive. For this y there exists a real-linear partial operator D:L2(S(y);R)->L2(S(y);E) with dense domain in the scalar L2 space, D closable and D.closure closed. Its original graph is exactly characterized by: for every scalar L2 class a and vector L2 class H, (a,H) belongs to D.graph iff there exists a smooth compactly supported real function phi with a=phi S(y)-almost everywhere and H=gradient(phi) S(y)-almost everywhere.
For every u in this SAME D.closure.domain, if D.closure(u)=0 as an actual vector L2(S(y)) class, there exists a real c such that the scalar quotient's standard representative equals c S(y)-almost everywhere.
One common R,S pair is chosen before all y. For each y one original D is chosen before ALL of its closure-domain u; a suitable D is not chosen afresh for each u. The constant c may depend on y and u and is selected after them. Potential/density/operator conclusions hold for every y, not only almost every y. The conditional-kernel property has its usual disintegration/version scope, not a claim that all possible conditional versions have these pointwise identities. All unannotated partition integrability/integrals use volume; graph and zero-output constancy use actual weighted quotient classes and AE under S(y). No rough classical derivative or Hessian is asserted. No joint measurable y-dependent operator/constant selector, constant-domain converse or full kernel equality, resolvent estimate, centered/epsilon-zero/range/Poincare or further inequality, core/main or expected-cost composition theorem is concluded.
objects: C2 V,NNReal alpha,beta,real eta; actual Gibbs mu,Gaussian augmentation J,midpoint-quadratic W_y; common genuine Markov/disintegrating kernels R,S and reflected pushforward; each fiber dense original closable weighted partial gradient D with closed closure and exact graph; ALL zero-output closure-domain elements u and their existential weighted-AE constants.
domains: Full finite-dimensional real Hilbert/Borel E with canonical volume,including0 and approved ambient instances. mu normalized tilt(-V),J actual independent mu*standardGaussian pushed by (x,g)->(x,x+sqrt(eta)*g). W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+||z-y||^2/(8eta). D on scalar/vector L2(S y),actual submodule closure domain/output,graph/constant AE under S y. Partition integrability/integrals under volume.
quantifiers: Universal E,V,alpha,beta,eta satisfying hypotheses; both Hessian bounds forall x,a. Let mu,J,W;exists ONE common R,S before forall y; reflection forall y; complete potential/operator block forall y. Exists SAME D per y before forall closure-domain u,output=0 -> exists real c with weighted-AE constancy. Exact original graph forall a,H with exists smooth compact generator. No epsilon/f/cutoff/resolvent quantifiers and no common constant c across u.
assumptions: V C2,alpha,beta NNReal with alpha cast>0,alpha<=beta; forall x,a alpha||a||^2<=actual nested-fderiv D2V(x)[a,a]<=beta||a||^2; eta>0,beta*eta<=1; approved full finite real Hilbert/Borel ambient E including0. W_y positive/integrable partition,dense D,closability/closed closure/exact graph are existential conclusions; for each u the zero actual closure-output is inner antecedent.
conclusion: Exists actual Markov R,S,R true conditional kernel for swapped J,reflection identity S y=(R y).map(x->2*x-y) all y. Every S y normalized tilt(-W_y),W_y C2,exp(-W_y) volume-integrable with positive integral;exists D dense domain,closable,closure closed,exact smooth compact gradient graph. ALL zero-output elements of this SAME D.closure are S y-AE real constants,with one c for each u.
scopes: Same R,S all y,same D per y before ALL u. All fiber identities/operator facts every y; conditional disintegration normal version scope. Zero is genuine vector L2 output,not rough pointwise classical derivative. Weighted-AE scalar constancy only,not constants-domain converse/full kernel equality. No joint measurable y-dependent operator/constant choice,centered/range/epsilon0/Poincare/further inequality,core/main/cost composition conclusion.
